# `company.purchase_coverage_links`

Immutable links from a purchase-order line to the order or work-order line it covers.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Immutable coverage link ULID. |
| `work_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_purchase_coverage_document | work_documents.id | Sales order or work order whose shortfall this covers. |
| `work_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | work_line_identities.id | Stable line identity of that document. |
| `purchase_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | purchase_orders.id | Purchase order written to cover it. |

| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC creation timestamp. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal recorded as creating this history. |
